title: Shift and cone closure of the projection-mate isomorphism locus
statement: Let $f:Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Choose the derived categories $D(\mathcal O_Z)$ and $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category] in a common arbitrary localization universe, their shared derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], a strong monoidal structure on $F=Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], and an adjunction $a:F\dashv R$, where $R=Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ and $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ put $p_K=a_{K\otimes R(E),F(K)\otimes E}(\mu^{-1}_{K,R(E)};(F(K)\otimes\epsilon_E))$ and let $P(K)$ assert that $p_K$ is an isomorphism. (1) For every integer $n$, if $P(A)$ and $B\cong A[n]$ in the ambient derived category, then $P(B)$. (2) If an ambient distinguished triangle has vertices isomorphic to $A,B,C$ respectively and $P(A)$ and $P(B)$, then $P(C)$. No assertion about perfect objects, coproducts, retracts or all objects belonging to $P$ is made.

proof.text: Use lem-sc-projection-comparison-exact to give exact integer-shift structures to S(K)=K tensor R(E), T(K)=R(F(K) tensor E), and to obtain shift compatibility of the explicit natural projection transformation eta. Naturality conjugates eta_X to eta_X' along any isomorphism X ≅ X'; its components therefore have the same invertibility. This conjugation is proved explicitly in Lean.

For shifts use Mathlib NatTrans.app_shift: eta_{A[n]} is the shift of eta_A conjugated by the source and target shift comparison isomorphisms. Functors preserve isomorphisms, so eta_{A[n]} is invertible if eta_A is. Conjugate along the given B ≅ A[n] using the naturality calculation.

For an ambient distinguished triangle construct the triangle morphism with components eta at its three vertices. Naturality proves its first two squares, and shift_app_comm plus naturality proves the connecting-map square. Exactness makes its source and target triangles distinguished. Conjugate along the first two given vertex isomorphisms, apply Mathlib Pretriangulated.isIso₃_of_isIso₁₂, then conjugate along the inverse third vertex isomorphism to prove the required component at C invertible.

proof_origin.place: U4: explicit naturality conjugation, shift conjugation, and Mathlib triangle two-out-of-three; geometric exact realization isolated in lem-sc-projection-comparison-exact

lean.statement:
theorem projectionComparison_triangles
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    (a : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z) :
    let P : ObjectProperty (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) := fun K ↦
      IsIso ((a.homEquiv _ _)
        ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (derivedPullback f) K.obj
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj)).inv ≫
            (derivedPullback f).obj K.obj ◁ a.counit.app E.obj))
    (∀ (A : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (n : ℤ), P A →
      ∀ (B : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y), Nonempty (B.obj ≅ A.obj⟦n⟧) → P B) ∧
    (∀ (A B : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y), P A → P B →
      ∀ (T : Pretriangulated.Triangle (schemeDerivedCategory Y)),
        T ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles →
        Nonempty (T.obj₁ ≅ A.obj) → Nonempty (T.obj₂ ≅ B.obj) →
        ∀ (C : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y), Nonempty (T.obj₃ ≅ C.obj) → P C)
